steps: Open Engagements, open the existing event, and select Edit Engagement.
Change Start and End in the engagement form. Keep each presentation within the event date range.
Select Save Changes in the bottom bar, then check the save confirmation.

on_pages.edit_engagement.php: You are already in Edit Engagement. Change Start and End in the event fields.

walkthrough.label: change event dates
walkthrough.request: How do I change the dates of an existing event?

event-dates-start.message: Open Engagements and choose the existing event whose dates need changing.
event-dates-start.label: open engagements

event-dates-record.message: Open the intended event from Engagements; do not create another event to change the dates.

event-dates-open.message: Select Edit Engagement to open this event’s form.
event-dates-open.label: show edit engagement

event-dates-review.message: Update Start and End in the event form. Keep End on or after Start, and keep every presentation within that range. Review those dates, then select i have reviewed the details.
event-dates-review.label: show start

event-dates-order.message: End is earlier than Start. Correct the date range before saving.
event-dates-order.label: show end

event-dates-save.message: Select Save Changes in the persistent bottom bar, then check the saved event dates and confirmation.
event-dates-save.label: show save changes

event-dates-errors.message: Read the validation message and correct the date or presentation fields before saving again.
event-dates-errors.label: show validation message

event-dates-check.message: Check the event’s displayed dates and the application confirmation. Navigation alone does not confirm a successful save.

event-dates-start-required.message: Start is required. Choose the event’s start date before reviewing the form.
event-dates-start-required.label: show start

event-dates-end-required.message: End is required. Choose the event’s end date before reviewing the form.
event-dates-end-required.label: show end

steps: Open Work Queue and find the existing task. Select its Edit task control.
In Assigned to, choose the intended user. Review the task and select Save changes.
Check the saved owner in Work Queue. The green check-mark completes a task; it does not assign it.

on_pages.edit_task.php: You are already in Edit Task. Find Assigned to in the form.

walkthrough.label: assign a task
walkthrough.request: How do I assign a task?

task-assign-start.message: Open My Work and find the existing task. Use its Edit task action to change the owner. The green check-mark completes work; it does not assign it.
task-assign-start.label: open my work

task-assign-record.message: Find the intended task and select Edit task. Do not use the green completion check-mark to assign it.

task-assign-owner.message: In Assigned to, choose the intended user, or Unassigned if nobody should own it. Review your selection, then select i have reviewed the details here.
task-assign-owner.label: show assigned to

task-assign-save.message: Review the task and select Save changes. Check the saved owner afterward; selecting a user alone has not saved the change.
task-assign-save.label: show save changes

task-assign-errors.message: Read the validation message before saving again.
task-assign-errors.label: show validation message

task-assign-check.message: Check the application confirmation and the task’s owner. A page change alone does not prove the reassignment succeeded.

steps: For an event task, open the event, select Tasks, then Add Task. For general work, open Work Queue and use + New Task.
Enter Title and Notes; verify Related record, Assigned to, Due date, Priority, and Status.
Select Add task and check that the task appears for the intended record.

on_pages.add_task.php: You are already in the task form. Start with Title and verify Related record.

walkthrough.label: add a task
walkthrough.request: How do I add a task?

task-create-start.message: Open My Work (Work Queue) and select + New Task. To attach work to an event, open that event and use its Tasks tab.
task-create-start.label: open my work

task-create-list.message: Select + New Task to open the task form. You choose whether this is general work or belongs to a record.
task-create-list.label: show new task

task-create-event.message: Select the Tasks tab first. Add Task is inside that panel.
task-create-event.label: show tasks

task-create-title.message: Enter Title to describe the task. Notes can hold the details; the coach does not read either field.
task-create-title.label: show title

task-create-review.message: Review Related record. To change it, use Change record, type at least three characters in Find a related record, then select the matching result. Review Assigned to, Due date, Priority, Status, and Notes. Select i have reviewed the details when ready.
task-create-review.label: show related record

task-create-save.message: Select Add task when ready. Check the application confirmation and that the new task belongs to the intended record. The coach has not saved it.
task-create-save.label: show add task

task-create-errors.message: Read the validation message and correct the form before trying Add task again.
task-create-errors.label: show validation message

task-create-check.message: Check the application confirmation and find the new task on the intended record or in My Work. Navigation alone does not confirm it was saved.

task-create-event-add.message: Select Add Task inside Tasks. The event is carried into the task form as its Related record.
task-create-event-add.label: show add task

steps: Find the task in Work Queue or the related record’s task list.
Select its green check-mark. MOED opens Complete Task?
Review the confirmation, then select Complete Task if the work is done. Cancel leaves it unchanged.
Find the task in Work Queue or the related record’s task list.
Select the Archive task box icon. Archiving retains its status and details while removing it from active work and reminders.
Check Archived in Work Queue to find it afterward. Required financial-closeout tasks cannot be archived to bypass closeout.
Open Work Queue and select Archived, or use View Archived Tasks on the related record.
Find the task and select Restore task. Its original status, owner, due date, and details are retained.
If its parent event or inquiry is archived, restore that parent first. A restored Completed task remains Completed.
Open Calendar and find Create Subscription. Enter Device or Service and choose the content to include.
Select Create Private Link. The Save This New Link section appears after creation.
Copy its one-time private URL into your calendar app as a subscribed calendar. Keep it private; it grants access to the selected content.

walkthrough.label: subscribe to your calendar
walkthrough.request: How do I subscribe to MOED in my own calendar?

calendar-start.message: Open Calendar and find Create Subscription. This creates a personal private link for your calendar application.
calendar-start.label: open calendar

calendar-name.message: Under Create Subscription, enter Device or Service, such as Personal phone.
calendar-name.label: show device or service

calendar-content.message: Choose one or more content options under Include in This Subscription. Review what you want to share with your calendar app, then select i have reviewed the details.
calendar-content.label: show content options

calendar-create-link.message: Select Create Private Link when ready. Save This New Link appears only after creation. The coach will not create the link for you.
calendar-create-link.label: show create private link

calendar-copy-link.message: Save This New Link is available. Use Copy calendar URL, then add it as a subscribed calendar in your calendar app. Keep the URL private and do not paste it into the coach.
calendar-copy-link.label: show copy calendar url

calendar-errors.message: Read the validation message and check the device label and content selection.
calendar-errors.label: show validation message

steps: Open Booking Pipeline and the active inquiry. An organization, title, and preferred dates are needed before conversion.
Select Convert to Engagement. Review the proposed event, conflicts, tasks to carry forward, and any unresolved next action.
Acknowledge applicable warnings and confirm only after reviewing the conversion. The original inquiry stays linked and becomes read-only.
Open Organizations and select Archived.
Find the record and select Restore organization.
Check that the record has returned to the current view.
Open Contacts and select Archived.
Its organization must be active; restore that organization first if necessary.
Find the record and select Restore contact.
Check that the record has returned to the current view.
Open Engagements and select Archived.
Its organization must be active; restore that organization first if necessary.
Find the record and select Restore event.
Check that the record has returned to the current view.
Open the event, select the Presentations tab, then Edit Presentations.
Find the intended presentation and select Remove current PPT. Do not also select a replacement file.
Review the pending change and select Save Changes in the bottom bar. Removal takes effect only after saving.

on_pages.edit_engagement.php: You are already in Edit Engagement. Find the intended presentation’s file fields.

steps: Open the event, select the Presentations tab, then Edit Presentations.
Find the intended presentation and select Remove current PDF. Do not also select a replacement file.
Review the pending change and select Save Changes in the bottom bar. Removal takes effect only after saving.

on_pages.edit_engagement.php: You are already in Edit Engagement. Find the intended presentation’s file fields.

steps: Open Organizations and select + New Organization.
Complete the organization’s required details, then review its addresses and contact information.
Select Create organization and check the save confirmation. Creating the organization does not create an event.
Open Contacts and select + New Contact.
Complete the person’s details and any organization affiliations. Event-specific contact roles are assigned separately when editing an event.
Select Create contact, then check the save confirmation.
Open the event and select Add Chron Log Entry.
Enter the note in the Chron form. Record the decision, conversation outcome, or useful context.
Select Save Chron Log Entry and check that it appears in the event’s Activity.
Open Account Security in the sidebar. Find Change Password.
Enter Current Password, New Password, and Confirm New Password. Use 12 or more characters, no more than 72 UTF-8 bytes. Do not put passwords in the coach.
Select Change Password. Check the confirmation; other sessions will be signed out. If MOED requests recent two-factor verification, sign in again first.
Open the existing task with Edit task. You are changing its Related record, not creating another task.

In Related record, select Change record if a record is already selected. Type at least three characters into Find a related record and choose the intended matching record. Searching alone does not select it.
Select Save changes and check the saved relationship.

on_pages.edit_task.php: You are already in Edit Task. Find Related record.

steps: Open the existing task with Edit task.
Enter or revise Notes in that task form. These are text notes; they are separate from presentation speaker-notes PDFs.
Select Save changes and check the task.

on_pages.edit_task.php: You are already in Edit Task. Find Notes.
